University Farm Nearly 6,000 acres under continuous research. A fully residential university Students, faculty and research, on one contiguous campus. 50,000+ alumni and counting Serving in leading roles into laboratories, ministries and industries, across India and the world. Established 1960 · India’s first Land Grant Pattern University India’s first agricultural university Six decades of research that feeds a nation Established in 1960 on the American land-grant model, the founding template for every state agricultural university in India. Eight colleges, 300+ released crop varieties, a research programme expanding into digital agriculture and AI.
